row.title: ROLE-ALIGN-1: every automated role names its human counterpart, its decisions and its clock
row.body: Owner asked (2026-11-26) what the roles are and how they align with human software development roles. doctrine/managers.json now carries human_role, decides, inputs, hands_to and cadence per role and a software_roles coverage map of 22 software-organization functions; managers --check enforces them and managers --roles prints them. No role was created outside the TEAM-1 phase gate: security, finance, data and developer relations are done today by code that existing roles own, and their dedicated roles stay in doctrine/team.json phase 2. Sales and partnerships is the one gap (Q-ROLE-sales-partnerships); no loop reads open secret-scanning and Dependabot alerts (Q-ROLE-security). The 12 scheduled manager workflows are declared clocks in doctrine/clocks.json; their beats are the workflow runs GitHub records, and the watchdog restarts them under their declared ids.
